full_judgment: 2. The suit was contested by Capital Ship Breakers Ltd and eventually it was decreed ex-parte on 26-6-05 with a direction upon the judgment debtor to pay the decreetal dues to the respondent Bank within 60(sixty) days but the judgment debtor did not pay the decreetal amount so the respondent Bank filed Artha Rin Execution Case No. 340 of 2005 before the same Court, During pendency of the execution case both the judgment debtor and the decree holder Bank (Islami Bank Bangladesh Ltd) compromised the matter amicably upon filing a solenarna. The Artha Rin Adalat, 1st Court, Chittagong accepted the said solenama and the execution case were disposed of according to the terms of the said solenama. As per the terms and condition of the said solenama the judgment debtor was to pay Taka 8(eight) crore as was stipulated in the solenama and in case of failure of selling the mortgaged property within 12 months the decree holder bank would have absolute right to sell the mortgaged property through Court and accordingly on failure to repay the decreetal amount the bank filed an application for restoration of the said execution case because of non-compliance of the terms of the compromise as referred to above, whereupon the execution case was restored to its original file and number. Thereafter, the judgment debtor Messrs Salam and Company brought Writ Petition No. 4070 of 2008 before the High Court Division relating to the proceedings of the said Execution Case No. 340 of 2005 which was rejected summarily on 4-6-2008 by a Division Bench of this Court, thereafter the petitioner Salam and Company being aggrieved by the said judgment and order dated 4-6-2008 passed by the High Court Division in Writ Petition No. 4070 of 2008 preferred Civil Petition For Leave To Appeal No. 1287 of 2008 before the Appellate Division but the said Leave Petition was dismissed on 12-5-2009 thereafter the petitioner preferred Civil Review Petition No. 49 of 2009 before the Appellate Division but the same was also dismissed for default.
